go_bus.text: The bus is late. You miss the start of the lecture.

wake_noodles.text: Your roommate already ate the last packet.

quad_friends.text: Someone needs R50. You send it.

res_party.text: A legendary night. People will tell it wrong, and better.

branches.text: A long lecture about your marks.

sleep.text: A fire alarm at 01:00. You stood outside in socks.

always.text: You feel a bit more room in the tank this week.

smig_sitin.text: "And you are...?" The lecturer squints. You leave a bit early.

smig_board.text: A tutoring flyer. You photograph it and feel employable.

smig_steps.text: A pigeon takes your chips. You do not look at it. It looks at you.

smig_case.text: One person does all the talking and none of the work. Classic.

smig_lab.text: The printer jams on page 7 of 8. You say a word in isiZulu.

smig_beanbag.text: You wake up with a beanbag pattern on your face. Everyone saw.

hs_sitin.text: The lecturer introduces the skeleton as "Bob". You will remember Bob.

hs_board.text: A first-aid volunteer call. You sign up and feel responsible.

hs_lawn.text: Ketchup lands on the coat. You say it is a "rehearsal".

hs_cards.text: "Name the cranial nerves." You name three songs instead.

hs_prac.text: The lab smell follows you to dinner. People move away.

hs_bob.text: You name every bone but one. Bob rattles smugly.

sci_sitin.text: The demo goes "pop". A small cheer goes up. The lecturer bows.

sci_board.text: Your lab is moved to 8am. You say something unprintable.

sci_fountain.text: The fountain splashes. Three people get soaked. One is you.

sci_report.text: Somebody spills coffee on the data. The data is now "approximate".

sci_open.text: The burner flares. Your eyebrows survive. Your confidence does not.

sci_lawn.text: A cloud looks exactly like an exam question. You get up.

law_sitin.text: "Objection!" shouts a student. The lecturer allows it.

law_board.text: You are on the roster. For next week. You are not ready.

law_steps.text: You argue that pap is better than rice. You lose, loudly.

law_moot.text: A heckler asks for "authority". You cite your gran.

law_read.text: You read the wrong case for forty minutes. A good case, though.

law_lurk.text: A mock trial runs over time. Someone cries, then wins.

eng_sitin.text: You copy a triangle. You do not know why. You trust it.

eng_board.text: A secondhand calculator for R40. It still has the exam on it.

eng_bridge.text: The bridge holds. The crowd roars. A stick flies off for emphasis.

eng_eggdrop.text: The egg survives the drop. You name it Mandla and cry a little.

eng_workshop.text: The drill escapes your hand. Your prototype now has a "feature".

eng_print.text: The print takes four hours. You watch two minutes and leave.

gate_guard.text: "Student card?" You show it. He nods like a proud uncle.

gate_vetkoek.text: The mince drips on your shirt. You wear it like a badge.

gate_taxi.text: A driver hoots at you. You do not know why. You wave anyway.

gate_spaza.text: The spaza is out of your chips. The owner suggests a better snack. He is right.

gate_wall.text: Golden hour hits. Someone takes your photo. You pretend you did not pose.

gate_visitors.text: The visitor book needs three signatures. The pen is on a string.

gate_night.text: He pours you tea from a flask. It is very sweet. You do not complain.

gate_curfew.text: The gate closes. You squeeze through. The guard pretends not to see.

quad_study.text: An ant walks across your highlighted line. You decide it is a sign.

quad_src.text: They hand out sweets. You vote with your mouth full.

quad_busker.text: He plays your song. You tip nothing. He nods like you did.

quad_touch.text: You score. Everyone claims it was their pass.

quad_dance.text: The speaker dies mid-song. You keep dancing. The crowd joins in.

quad_clouds.text: You fall asleep. A friend draws on your sleeve with a pen.

quad_lights.text: A moth lands on your nose. You sit very, very still.

quad_longway.text: Somewhere a speaker plays something old. You hum it all the way.

caf_queue.text: The tannie at the counter gives you an extra egg. You did nothing to deserve it.

caf_grab.text: The muffin is yesterday's. It is still a muffin. You respect it.

caf_between.text: You burn your tongue on the soup and taste nothing until Thursday.

caf_table.text: The table is planning a braai. You are now in the group chat.

lib_drop.text: Your bag holds the best plug point all day. Legend.

lib_between.text: You read the same paragraph four times. The fifth time it lands.

lib_group.text: The librarian shushes you by name. You have arrived.

lib_printer.text: Printer says "PC LOAD LETTER". Nobody knows what that means. R5 gone.

lib_night.text: Load shedding hits. The generator kicks in. Everyone claps quietly.

sport_stretch.text: Someone's gogo is doing better stretches than you. Respect.

sport_pass.text: You get swept into a warm-up jog. You go with it.

sport_gap.text: You arrive at your next lecture still sweating. Back row it is.

sport_pickup.text: You nutmeg a guy from Engineering. He will remember this.

sport_watch.text: You catch a stray ball one-handed. The stand loses it.

bus_early.text: The driver plays gqom at 7am. The queue bops as one.

bus_timetable.text: The timetable says 08:10. The bus says "eish".

bus_back.text: The book was in your bag the whole time. You sit in silence.

bus_town.text: You find a quarter bunny for R30 and feel like a king.

bus_last.text: The driver waits as you sprint. The whole bus cheers.

res_o_lock.text: You go back to check the plug. It was off. It is always off.

res_o_notes.text: Your roommate already took photos of the notes. Hero.

res_o_corridor.text: You learn three secrets and one rumour about the warden.

res_o_cook.text: Half the floor smells your onions and appears with plates.

res_o_late_chat.text: The neighbour on the other side joins in. It is now a podcast.

res_r_breakfast.text: Someone made extra tea and left the pot. Quiet Block kindness.

res_r_out.text: The door creaks. Twelve people sigh at once.

res_r_reading.text: You wake up with the textbook on your face. Page 3.

res_r_tea.text: They share rusks from home. The good ones. With aniseed.

res_r_lights.text: Someone whispers "night, everyone". Everyone whispers back.

res_s_fridge.text: Your name is on it. Someone ate it anyway. A note says "sorry bru".

res_s_out.text: The whole courtyard walks in sync like a music video.

res_s_ball.text: Five minutes becomes forty. You run to class in slides.

res_s_stoep.text: A taxi passes playing amapiano. The stoep dances seated.

res_s_kitchen.text: Someone brings out leftover curry. Midnight feast unlocked.

res_other_kettle.text: The kettle trips the plug. The whole passage blames you.

res_other_out.text: Wrong stair. You end up at the laundry. Again.

res_other_quiet.text: No one is around. You finish the chapter and a snack.

res_other_floor.text: They are from your home town. You know their aunty. Of course.

res_other_wash.text: Machine 3 eats one sock. The chat names it "The Taxman".

off_pack.text: You remember the charger. Load shedding is today. It does not matter.

off_stop.text: The neighbour's dog walks you to the stop. Free bodyguard.

off_return.text: You get back and the lecturer did not even use the textbook.

off_supper.text: Your landlady sends you off with a Tupperware of samp and beans.

off_couch.text: One episode becomes four. The couch has won.

off_late.text: The gate key sticks. The neighbour helps. You owe him a Coke.
